'''Professor Alden''' (Japanese: '''ウメズ教授''' ''Professor Umezu'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG002|A Ruin with a View]]''. He is an archaeologist who had his base in the [[Pokémon Center]] of [[Oldale Town]] as he studied the [[Oldale Ruins]].

He showed {{Ash}} and {{an|May}} the nearby Oldale Ruins and informed them about the Pokémon that resided there. Suddenly, [[Team Magma]] members arrived and blackmailed Alden so that he could give them access to the ruins. He was kidnapped by Team Magma. Ultimately, he succumbed to their threats and opened up a secret chamber of the ruins with the help of four colored orbs for the grunts to enter. Team Magma inspected the room and eventually left, dissatisfied with what they found, leaving Alden unharmed. 

Ash and May arrived on the scene just too late and saw Team Magma escaping in a helicopter. Afterwards, {{AP|Pikachu}} used {{m|Thunderbolt}} to send {{TRT}} blasting off, which helped recover the four keys. Professor Alden placed the treasures inside a cubed stone within the stone chamber. This uncovered a hidden stairwell, which led to an underground lake filled with the prehistoric Pokémon {{p|Relicanth}}, something he found helpful for his studies on the relationship between ancient people and Pokémon.

He reappeared in a flashback in ''[[AG027|A Three Team Scheme!]]''.
